entries.title: A lament against the times
entries.literal_meaning: Let the ways of this age burn: while the grandfather is still alive, the grandson dies.
entries.explanation: The curse against the age is followed by a death that reverses the expected generational order. Our reading hears grief protesting that reversal. The line names no cause or particular family, and its anger at “the times” is not evidence that an era caused the death.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯୁଗକୁ ଅଭିଶାପ ଦେବା ପରେ ଏମିତି ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ଆସେ ଯାହା ପିଢ଼ିର ଆଶାକରା କ୍ରମକୁ ଓଲଟାଇ ଦିଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଶୋକ ସେ ଓଲଟାଣିକୁ ପ୍ରତିବାଦ କରୁଥିବା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। କଥାଟି କୌଣସି କାରଣ ବା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପରିବାରର ନାମ ଦିଏନାହିଁ; “ଯୁଗ” ପ୍ରତି ରାଗ ମୃତ୍ୟୁର କାରଣ ଯୁଗ ଥିଲା ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears grief resisting an expected order overturned.
entries.odia_summary: ଆଶାକରା କ୍ରମ ଓଲଟିଗଲେ ଶୋକର ପ୍ରତିବାଦକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ଶୁଣେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ପାଠ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଯୁଗକୁ କାହିଁକି ଦୋଷ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ହୁଏତ କାରଣ ବୁଝାଇବାଠାରୁ ଦୁଃଖକୁ କହିବା ଏଠି ମୁଖ୍ୟ।” / A reading group asks why the age is blamed. Someone suggests that expressing grief may matter more here than explaining a cause. This discussion is invented, not testimony from a bereaved family.
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary supplies the phrase “spirit of the age.” No historical mortality pattern, named death or literal call to burn anything is established.

entries.title: An alliance regretted
entries.literal_meaning: Seeing a great household, I made a kinship alliance; I took my daughter and gave her to Yama.
entries.explanation: The dictionary defines the great household by wealth and standing. The speaker’s first-person account turns that attraction into the terrible image of giving a daughter to Yama. Our reading hears regret over judging an alliance by status. The image does not establish an actual death, a particular form of harm or a story about every wealthy family.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନ “ବଡ଼ ଘର”କୁ ଧନ ଓ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠାରେ ଚିହ୍ନାଏ। ବକ୍ତାର ନିଜ କଥାରେ ସେ ଆକର୍ଷଣ ଝିଅକୁ ଯମ ହାତରେ ଦେବାର ଭୟଙ୍କର ଛବିକୁ ଫେରେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦା ଦେଖି ବନ୍ଧୁତା ବିଚାର କରିଥିବାର ଅନୁତାପ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଏହି ଛବି ପ୍ରକୃତ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ, ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କ୍ଷତି ବା ସବୁ ଧନୀ ପରିବାରର କାହାଣୀ ସ୍ଥାପନ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears regret when family prestige becomes the basis of an alliance.
entries.odia_summary: ପରିବାରର ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠାକୁ ବନ୍ଧୁତାର ଆଧାର କରିବାର ଅନୁତାପ ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “ଏହାକୁ ଧନୀ ଘର ଖରାପ ବୋଲି ପଢ଼ିବା?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ମୁଁ ବରଂ କେବଳ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା ଦେଖି ବିଚାର କରିବାର ଅନୁତାପ ପଢ଼ୁଛି।” / A reader asks whether the line condemns wealthy households. Another replies, “I read regret about judging by prestige alone.” This critical discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The daughter and kinship language suggest a marriage alliance; no marriage event, dowry account or abuse history is supplied. Yama is retained as the source’s death image.

entries.title: Something to console the mind
entries.literal_meaning: Nothing but nothing: mere kanji water to console the mind.
entries.explanation: The repeated dismissal makes the consolation sound slight. The dictionary explains the headword as an act that satisfies expectations left unmet. Our reading stays with that small substitute: it may soothe disappointment without becoming the thing originally hoped for. The source supplies no actual meal or measure of the food’s value.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାରମ୍ବାର ତୁଚ୍ଛ କହିବାରେ ସାନ୍ତ୍ୱନାଟି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନ ମନମୁରୁଛାକୁ ଅପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଆଶାରେ ମନକୁ ବୁଝାଇବାର କାମ ବୋଲି ବୁଝାଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ସେହି ଛୋଟ ବଦଳି ଜିନିଷ ପାଖରେ ରହେ—ନିରାଶାକୁ କିଛି ଶାନ୍ତ କରିପାରେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଚାହିଁଥିବା ଜିନିଷ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ। ଉତ୍ସ କୌଣସି ପ୍ରକୃତ ଭୋଜନ ବା ଖାଦ୍ୟର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading distinguishes a small consolation from a fulfilled wish.
entries.odia_summary: ଛୋଟ ସାନ୍ତ୍ୱନା ଓ ପୂରଣ ହୋଇଥିବା ଆଶାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ବଡ଼ ନାଟକ ଦେଖିବାର ଯୋଜନା ବାତିଲ ହେଲା। ସାଙ୍ଗମାନେ ଘରେ ଏକ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ ପଢ଼ିଲେ। ଜଣେ ଢଗଟି ମନେ ପକାଇ କହିଲେ, “ସମାନ ନୁହେଁ, ତଥାପି ମନକୁ କିଛି ବୁଝାଇଲା।” / A planned theatre visit is cancelled. Friends read one scene together at home. Recalling the saying, someone remarks, “It is not the same, but it is some consolation.” This use is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Kanji water is retained as the food expression; the record establishes neither a recipe nor nutritional inferiority. The dismissive valuation belongs to the line’s rhetoric.
